35655751.patient_population: 479 patients with ASD and 478 age/gender-matched normal controls
35655751.model_description: Input: functional MRI brain imaging data; output: machine-learning (random SVM cluster) identification of ASD-related brain regions and classification of ASD versus controls.

35768114.model_description: Protocol proposing prognostic models combining demographic, clinical and MRI metrics (assessed 1 month post-injury) with machine learning algorithms to predict motor, cognitive, behavioral and school outcomes at 6 months after pediatric TBI.

35774299.model_name: MP-ViT (Multisemantic Level Patch Merger Vision Transformer)

35785663.clinical_problem: automatic measurement of fetal head circumference in prenatal ultrasound screening

35797364.model_family: conjunctive clause evolutionary algorithm (CCEA) with k-nearest-neighbors validation

35797364.model_description: Input: structural MRI-derived neuroanatomical measures (volume, area, cortical thickness, curvature) and behavioral/theory-of-mind measures; output: evolutionary-algorithm feature selection and k-NN classification for ASD diagnosis/biomarker identification.

35811397.model_description: Input: fused gray-scale and microflow placental ultrasound images; output: classification of placental features associated with gestational diabetes versus normal pregnancy.

35815018.clinical_problem: using multimodal brain MRI biomarkers to understand how maternal nutrition affects infant brain development
35815018.patient_population: review discussing pregnant women and infants (prenatal period through the first year of life)

35843515.clinical_problem: automatic brain tissue segmentation in pediatric patients with severe brain distortion or lesions
35843515.patient_population: training: nearly 1,000 healthy individuals; test: several tens of individuals with severe brain distortions (pediatric)

35843515.dataset_size: ~1,000 healthy individuals (training), several tens with severe distortions (test)

35847931.clinical_problem: detection of pneumonia on chest X-ray, framed around childhood pneumonia mortality

35992933.clinical_problem: predicting pre-eclampsia in patients with gestational hypertension
35992933.patient_population: 138 pregnant women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (58 pre-eclampsia, 80 gestational hypertension)
35992933.model_description: Input: radiomics features from diffusion-weighted imaging and apparent diffusion coefficient maps combined with maternal age and BMI; output: nomogram predicting progression to pre-eclampsia from gestational hypertension.

36016875.clinical_problem: differentiating cholesteatoma, Langerhans cell histiocytosis, and middle ear inflammation of the temporal bone in children

36085937.clinical_problem: diagnosis of craniosynostosis using 3D photogrammetric head-shape scans as an alternative to CT

36109720.model_family: graph-theory connectome analysis with follow-up machine learning
36109720.clinical_problem: identifying brain connectome biomarkers of risk for serious mental illness in youth

36733926.patient_population: 190 infants with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy and 89 controls, full-term (37+ weeks gestation)

36741093.clinical_problem: automated measurement of acetabular index on pelvic radiographs for developmental dysplasia of the hip assessment
